ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) mass occupies the central and medial regions of both lobes. High-intensity (white) pixel clusters and mottling are localized at the distal tips and along the trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary with low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations; identifiable peaks are concentrated on the medial-to-distal section of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct concave curve from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters distributed across the dark pigmentation of both lobes, representing barnacle attachment points or scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several vertical-to-oblique high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) distributed across both lobes, particularly prominent on the distal portions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring patterns including both punctate rosette marks and linear rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface.
